summary: For Honor entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: For Honor
entries.definitive_edition: Current official PC live-service build with owned heroes/content

primary.why: For Honor is an ongoing Ubisoft live-service melee action game, and PC gives the best capture/settings route. Archive value depends on current build, account, heroes, owned expansions, and active modes/events.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Ubisoft Connect or Steam PC version. Record build/date, account, heroes/factions, edition/DLC ownership, graphics settings, controller, mode, matchmaking/server state, and current event or season context.

secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting console-specific performance or account state.
secondary.why: The core service overlaps, but platform account and performance can differ.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, patch, account, edition/DLC ownership, and event/season state.
